gripOrHq.title: HQ Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Custodial Position
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

gripOrHq.title: R&D Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Employee Empowerment
scoreArea.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Remapping
scoreArea.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Datacomb
ice.rulesText: *End the run. If Runner passes Datacomb, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.

root.title: Dieter Esslin
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dieter Esslin, Dieter does 1 Net damage.

ice.title: Glacier
ice.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
